title: Mixing: Ram by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eirik Wangberg

A final mixing session for the Ram album by Paul and Linda McCartney took place on 7 May 1971.

Studio engineer Eirik Wangberg created mono mixes of each of the songs on this day, for US radio stations. Ram was released in the UK on 21 May, and in the US on 17 May.

The mono mixes were released in May 2012 as part of the Paul McCartney Archive Collection. It was included as part of the deluxe edition box set, and was also given a limited edition standalone release on vinyl.

Page last updated: 13 November 2025
